_doc: Q-COST-PROOF-1: data read by deploy/cost-probe.mjs. A database whose rows read over window_days exceeds rows_read_max (or its per-database override) files one queue item; Workers AI neurons over the same window above neurons_max files one. Change a number here, never in the script. Resource discovery files an item for each account resource that doctrine/topology.json does not declare when its name starts with a prefix in file_prefixes; other undeclared names (the Quniverse test bed on the same account) are recorded in ops/cost.jsonl as a foreign count and filed only when file_foreign is true. READ-BUDGET-1 (2026-11-16): the limits are the Cloudflare free plan's, per 7 days: 14 million rows read per database (two databases share the account's 35 million) and 70,000 Workers AI neurons.
